channel.title: Bible Answer
channel.description: Reading guides and news from Bible Answer.

item.title: Where to start reading the Bible
item.description: Choose a manageable first Bible reading, explore the Gospel of John, and use four simple questions to understand a passage before applying it.

item.title: What comes after “I’m sorry”?
item.description: Read Ephesians 4:25–32 in context and explore what kindness, honest words, and a concrete repair can add to an apology in an ordinary conversation.

item.title: Gratitude on a hard day
item.description: Read 1 Thessalonians 5:14–22 alongside its words about patience and care, then try an honest prayer that names both a difficulty and a gift.

item.title: Asking for wisdom before a decision
item.description: Read James 1:2–8 in context, understand its invitation to ask for wisdom, and use a simple reflection to name one missing piece of information.

item.title: bibleanswer.app is open in six languages
item.description: The Bible Answer website is live in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish, Russian, French and Filipino, with a press kit, the privacy policy and support.
